scoring_justification: Tg can be recomputed from the agent's raw density vs temperature CSV using piecewise linear fitting on reduced volume, matching the paper's method. No reliance on self-reported metrics.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference value for glass transition temperature
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (cooling rate 20 K/ns, degree of polymerization 100, 3 chains)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value 450 K is the exact reported Tg for the exact condition the task asks to reproduce.

outputs.description: Raw density vs. temperature data from the cooling simulation, used by the checker to recompute the glass transition temperature.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the glass transition temperature in Kelvin.

outputs.description: Agent-reported Tg computed from density data via piecewise linear fitting of reduced volume.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes Tg from density_vs_temperature.csv using orthogonal distance regression on reduced volume and compares both the recomputed Tg and the agent's reported Tg to a hidden reference value (with tolerance). The CSV must contain at least 30 data points and cover from above 550 K to below 400 K.

steps.description: Validate CSV shape (≥30 rows, temperature range covers >550 K and <400 K) and recompute Tg from the density data using piecewise linear fit on reduced volume. Compare recomputed Tg to hidden gold (450 K) with ±10 K tolerance.
Compare the agent's self-reported Tg to the hidden gold (450 K) with ±10 K tolerance.
